column1: # config-lanes.tsv — lane manifest for jobs/config-backup.sh (data only, operator-editable).
# Columns (TAB-separated): lane | repo (path relative to $HOME) | push remote (empty = none, like gbd push_skipped) | sources (space-separated, each relative to $HOME).
# Paths are expanded to absolute at read time by config-backup.sh. Mirrors gbd ~/.config/git-back-dots/config.toml.
# NOTE: gbd's agent-configs HEAD also carries files tracked earlier but since dropped from config.toml (opencode.json,
# oh-my-openagent.json, day-ralph.*, ~/.local/bin scripts); gbd syncs only tracked_paths but never deletes old worktree
# copies, and its `git add -A` keeps committing them. The dry-run parity diff reports those as head-only leftovers; this
# lane declares gbd's CURRENT tracked set only.
